verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a SaaS automation product, but the evidence shows no user-configurable scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow feature in TaxJar. AutoFile automatically handles state returns and remittances by their deadlines. That is a vendor-managed recurring filing service, an adjacent feature rather than a way for users to schedule their own jobs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: AutoFile handles state tax returns and remittances for you, ensuring deadlines are never missed
